nodes.title: INPUT CHANNELS
nodes.body:
Microphone / phone / HUD controls / Telegram / Mail Link / WhatsApp / email / timers / sensors / files.
Details: Section 02.

nodes.title: INGRESS & PERMISSIONS
nodes.body:
Authentication, owner/guest/private-call policy, echo filtering, activity and consent. Some inputs become commands; others become evidence.
Details: 03-04, 10.

nodes.title: ROUTE, THINK, EXECUTE
nodes.body:
Gemini conversation; existing tool grammar; Perplexity at specific decision gates; backend/research/code workers.
Details: 04-09.

nodes.title: OUTPUT FAN-OUT
nodes.body:
Voice, captions, UI, notifications, drafts, sent messages, calendar/doc changes, desktop/device effects, archives, status or deliberate silence.
Details: 11-12.

nodes.title: DESKTOP MICROPHONE
nodes.body:
Wake phrase / push-to-talk -> wake client -> room creation -> microphone uplink -> LiveKit audio.
Continue at 03.

nodes.title: PHONE / JARVISLINK
nodes.body:
Authenticated phone session or scheduled invitation -> private room and mobile audio. Phone telemetry/photos are separate data paths.
Continue at 03 / 10 / 11.

nodes.title: HUD / DESKTOP CONTROLS
nodes.body:
Tauri frontend buttons, tray, taskbar, typed commands and /talk audio -> authenticated bridge endpoints.
Direct controls -> 04 / 05; audio -> 03.

nodes.title: TELEGRAM / MAIL LINK
nodes.body:
Approved chat text/voice notes or authenticated command email -> text command routing / chat / bounded task controls. Mail Link checks sender alignment and replay.
Continue at 04.

nodes.title: UNREAD EMAIL
nodes.body:
Gmail poll + parsed headers/body -> filters, triage, drafts and event suggestions. This is not the command-mail channel.
Continue at 09.

nodes.title: WHATSAPP CHAT INPUT
nodes.body:
WhatSie/headless adapter reads eligible unread chats; optional photos become descriptions. Per-chat permissions select available personas.
Continue at 08.

nodes.title: FILES / VISUAL EVIDENCE
nodes.body:
Explicitly supplied paths, selected active window, camera frames, phone photos and consented observations. Evidence is not permission.
Continue at 05 / 10.

nodes.title: TIME / EVENTS / SENSORS
nodes.body:
Reminders, exams, calendar, jobs, system health, presence, input idle, public event feeds and paper-market quotes.
Continue at 11.

nodes.title: WAKE / PHONE / PTT
nodes.body: Accepted audio session -> authenticated room/token. Owner/guest/private-session identity stays attached to the session.

nodes.title: LIVEKIT TRANSPORT
nodes.body: Microphone audio in; agent and phone session connect; captions/data-channel events travel beside audio.

nodes.title: REALTIME: GEMINI LIVE
nodes.body: Audio -> Gemini native activity/turn detection -> native conversation + function calls -> native speech audio. No separate Whisper/Silero gate on this branch.

nodes.title: SPOKEN / TEXT OUTPUT
nodes.body: Audio -> laptop/phone speakers. Text/transcripts -> captions and HUD. Tool results re-enter the live model; interruptions use the realtime adapter.

nodes.title: DIRECT BRANCH
nodes.body: LiveKit audio + local Silero endpointing. Uses local-server transport; Gemini reasoning still uses a cloud API.

nodes.title: LOCAL WHISPER STT
nodes.body:
Faster-Whisper converts speech to text. Strict commands may run through the fast path before the text model.
Continue at 04.

nodes.title: GEMINI TEXT BRAIN
nodes.body: Default gemini-3.8-flash via direct Google client. Existing text-model fallback chain; tool results feed back into conversation.

nodes.title: PIPER TTS
nodes.body: Sentence streaming -> local ONNX voice -> playback gate -> speakers/captions. Optional configured cloud TTS override exists.

nodes.title: LOCAL / CLOUD-INFERENCE BRANCH
nodes.body: Despite its name, this branch uses LiveKit Cloud Inference for STT and the text model.

nodes.title: ASSEMBLYAI STT
nodes.body: assemblyai/universal-streaming -> transcript; local turn/command handling remains a separate branch from realtime native audio.

nodes.title: GEMINI VIA INFERENCE
nodes.body: Gemini text LLM and its tool collection -> model response. Specialist agents use the branch-appropriate shared LLM.

nodes.title: LOCAL VOICE OR OVERRIDE
nodes.body: Piper by default; configured JARVIS_TTS can choose an inference voice. Output converges with the common playback/HUD path.

nodes.title: FRESH OWNER TURN
nodes.body: Transcript/text plus allowed context: recent dialogue, memory, telemetry and tool results. Guest/private-call rules restrict available capabilities.

nodes.title: EARLY TRUSTED CONTROLS
nodes.body: Echo/consent checks -> visual-control commands -> supported goodnight ingress -> feature sessions -> protocols. Realtime audio remains owned by Gemini.

nodes.title: TEXT FAST PATH
nodes.body: Only on text pipelines: strict grammar -> intent resolver / optional Needle -> read-goal routing -> existing verified tool. Unmatched text falls through to Gemini.

nodes.title: DIRECT JARVIS
nodes.body:
Conversation / quick explanations / arithmetic -> answer. Current quick facts -> search. Volume/media/apps/calendar etc. -> own tools.
Tools: 05; outputs: 12.

nodes.title: UNCLEAR / DEEP REQUEST
nodes.body: route_request(request) is advisory only. ask_backend(task) independently checks the route before creating a background job.

nodes.title: PERPLEXITY DECIDER
nodes.body: Larger pplx-decider-v1.2 -> typed destination + explicit provider preference. Below 0.8 / failure -> direct, except an anchored explicit backend request is retained.

nodes.title: FOUR DESTINATIONS
nodes.body:
direct -> Jarvis
backend -> ask_backend / Section 06
research -> research_project / 07
code -> code_project / 07.
A label itself executes nothing.

nodes.title: RETURN TO CONVERSATION
nodes.body: Direct advice returns without spawning work. Confirmed background start returns an acknowledgement; later completion feeds the result back to the owner.

nodes.title: DESKTOP & WINDOWS
nodes.body:
App launch/close, visible URLs, focus/list/arrange windows, keyboard/mouse automation, file operations and power actions.
Outputs: desktop effects + verified/unverified receipts.

nodes.title: MEDIA & DOWNLOADS
nodes.body: YouTube resolution/playback in the system browser; media keys; direct video downloads and local output files. Backend browser is separate from visible playback.

nodes.title: DEVICES & SMART HOME
nodes.body:
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, audio sinks, monitors, keyboard lighting, USB inspection, KDE Connect and optional Home Assistant.
Outputs: device state, transfers or control effects.

nodes.title: WEB / SHOPPING / REDDIT
nodes.body: Helper Google / search APIs / DuckDuckGo; read-only backend browsing; structured shopping results; Reddit tools. Purchases and posting retain approvals.

nodes.title: MAIL / WHATSAPP
nodes.body: Read threads, draft and review responses, inspect prior activity, approved mimic lists and exact-recipient send workflows. Automation paths also run independently.

nodes.title: DOCS / SHEETS / DRIVE / NOTION
nodes.body:
Read/search/export; new documents and invoices; guarded updates to existing content; Google sharing and returned URLs.
Outputs: cloud document changes + previews.

nodes.title: CALENDAR & EXAMS
nodes.body: Read upcoming events; schedule-file/email extraction -> preview -> confirm import; manage stored exam timetable and reminders.

nodes.title: FILES & LIBRARIAN
nodes.body: Second-brain index, document retrieval, local/Drive source search, PDFs, exact-location source hits and opening files. Evidence feeds answers or draft work.

nodes.title: MEMORY & ACTIVITY
nodes.body:
Explicit remember/forget, recall decisions and prior sessions; activity tracking; pick up where left off.
Outputs: answer/context or vault/state updates.

nodes.title: FOCUS / SCHOOL / PROTOCOLS
nodes.body: Focus window/time sessions; school quiet/feature policy; protocol commands, suit/HUD controls and context-specific behaviour.

nodes.title: VISION / SCREEN / WATCH
nodes.body:
On-demand visual questions; foreground OCR; shared camera; scoped observation, posture/gestures and monitor summaries. Consent restrictions apply.
Details: 10.

nodes.title: CODE / TESTS / PROJECTS
nodes.body:
Dedicated coding proposals; background tests; failure explanation; reviewed PR opening; archive navigation.
Coding proposal is not patch application.

nodes.title: TASKS / WORKSHOP / SCHEDULE
nodes.body:
Multi-step plans, read-only research/code/ops workshop, timers, reminders, scheduled phone calls, cancellation and status.
Details: 07 / 11.

nodes.title: PUBLIC INTELLIGENCE / SECURITY
nodes.body: Passive OSINT and bounded network/system information; active pentest tools behind the dedicated specialist/scope gates.

nodes.title: GAMES / CHESS / ROBLOX
nodes.body: Launch game windows, voice chess commands and game speech/UI state; desktop launcher for supported game clients.

nodes.title: HEALTH / HUD / INSIGHTS
nodes.body:
Measured latency and incidents, system stats, monitor lifecycle, panels, AI-usage tracker and paper-market dashboards.
Outputs: visual status and diagnostic evidence.

nodes.title: ASK_BACKEND GUARD
nodes.body: Perplexity must return backend; direct/research/code decisions return guidance and backend_started=false. Original full task and provider preference are preserved.

nodes.title: PROVIDER POOL
nodes.body: Auto defaults to ChatGPT first; explicit Claude/ChatGPT preference sets first attempt. Known limit-hit providers rest for 300 seconds. Actual remaining quota is not guessed.

nodes.title: ISOLATED TEXT WORKER
nodes.body:
ChatGPT: existing headless Codex backend model.
Claude: subscription-authenticated CLI, no tools/MCP/skills, no saved session, neutral temporary cwd. Both get only the supplied text task.

nodes.title: ANSWER / LIMIT / ERROR
nodes.body:
Success -> return answer to Jarvis.
Recognised limit/unavailability -> other provider within time budget.
Ambiguous timeout/error -> report failure, not blind replay.

nodes.title: IN-DEPTH RESEARCH
nodes.body: Explicit research request -> research_project -> authenticated bridge /projects -> durable research metadata/progress.

nodes.title: CHATGPT RESEARCH WORKER
nodes.body: Existing research model with WebSearch/WebFetch and bounded execution. Reads public sources and writes a sourced report.

nodes.title: PROJECT ARCHIVE
nodes.body: report.md + sources.md + summary/status/progress. Completion/cancel/error are persisted. Live caller can poll completion.

nodes.title: OWNER DELIVERY
nodes.body: Spoken summary when live; archive UI/report file and existing notification policy otherwise. No claim of a report until completion.

nodes.title: CODING REQUEST
nodes.body: code_project -> private/guest checks -> authenticated bridge -> explicitly activated dedicated Assigner queue.

nodes.title: ASSIGNER + WORKERS
nodes.body: Trusted bounded source inventory and dependency context -> validated coordinator plan -> isolated no-tools generate/review workers. Existing fixed worker model allowlist.

nodes.title: VALIDATED PROPOSAL
nodes.body: Strict patch-hunk validation, hashes, manifests, raw results and proposal.patch in archive. Block if context/settings/proposal are invalid.

nodes.title: REVIEW, NOT AUTO-APPLY
nodes.body: Owner reviews proposal. Applying patches, running tests, merging or deployment remain separate actions. Existing run_tests/open_pr tools have their own workflows.

nodes.title: MULTI-STEP TASK / WORKSHOP
nodes.body: start_task plans think/research/write/consequential steps. Workshop chooses scoped research/code/ops specialists; these are read-only roles.

nodes.title: BOUNDED EXECUTION
nodes.body: Task state/revision/lease locks; background model steps and prior-result context. Consequential actions are separated and paused for owner approval.

nodes.title: MERGE / PREPARE
nodes.body: Task outputs or workshop reports -> stored status and write-up. Cancellation has settlement receipts; a speech interruption is not an external undo.

nodes.title: READ BACK / HAND BACK
nodes.body: Jarvis reports progress/results. Approved consequential steps return to the normal guarded tools; workshop never modifies the world by itself.

nodes.title: UNREAD CHAT / PHOTOS
nodes.body: Wait gate -> read recent chat -> optional photo description. Self/blocklist, group mention, owner-active, muted, one-note and fingerprint checks run first.

nodes.title: PERPLEXITY PERSONA
nodes.body:
Allowed choices built by code:
Jarvis always; owner_style only approved mimic chats; rude_jarvis only enabled + not trusted. Latest messages distinguished from history.

nodes.title: PERSONA-SPECIFIC WRITER
nodes.body:
Jarvis / rude Jarvis: existing ChatGPT fast writer.
Owner style: optional free style analyst + real-owner examples + existing mimic writer. Writer failure uses existing OpenRouter fallback.

nodes.title: VALIDATE & DELIVER
nodes.body: Uncertainty/failure -> polite Jarvis. Bot-identity / sensitive mimic requests -> owner handoff, no reply. Disallowed rude reply suppressed. Live auto-reply -> WhatsApp text + digest; dry -> saved evidence only.

nodes.title: EXPLICIT OUTGOING MESSAGE
nodes.body: Owner asks to send/reply to a recipient -> canonical draft record. This separate workflow is not permission granted by the persona model.

nodes.title: EXACT RECIPIENT REVIEW
nodes.body: Open/read back the selected recipient and message. The private owner phone workflow requires a fresh exact spoken challenge.

nodes.title: SINGLE-USE AUTHORIZATION
nodes.body: Recheck identity, exact draft, recipient and current channel; reject stale/generic approvals and model-invented confirmation.

nodes.title: MESSAGE / RECEIPT / REFUSAL
nodes.body: Confirmed transport send returns its receipt. Refusal or uncertainty is reported honestly. No simulated click is allowed to replace the approval gate.

nodes.title: GMAIL POLL + FILTERS
nodes.body: Unread IDs -> bounded fetch/parse -> seen/retry state. Skip own/undeliverable noise; distinguish bulk/human; keyword/classroom triage.

nodes.title: PERPLEXITY URGENCY / SCAM
nodes.body: Two yes/no questions in one request. Urgent >=0.5; scam >=0.8 overrides urgency. Failure/incomplete response -> existing ChatGPT judge -> keyword fallback if unavailable.

nodes.title: MAIL-SPECIFIC POLICY
nodes.body: High/normal/skip outcome; dedupe and sender/thread acknowledgement limits. Draft engine creates bounded replies; configured auto-ack is a distinct preauthorised path.

nodes.title: MAIL OUTPUTS
nodes.body: Draft queue / relaxed or urgent acknowledgement when enabled / urgent notification or owner message / logged normal mail. Explicit reviewed mail sends retain confirmation.

nodes.title: EMAIL / SCHEDULE FILE
nodes.body: Dated content in mail, a supplied PDF/image/text schedule, or an explicit conversation import.

nodes.title: EVENT GATE / EXTRACTION
nodes.body: Incoming email gate: p(event)<0.05 skips ChatGPT. Otherwise existing ChatGPT extracts structured dates/times; validators reject bad/past/uncertain entries.

nodes.title: PENDING SUGGESTION
nodes.body: Future event candidates and previews are saved. Read back event details; owner must confirm the exact import or suggestion.

nodes.title: CALENDAR OR NO CHANGE
nodes.body: Confirmed candidate -> Google Calendar event + receipt. Decline -> dismissed state. No event / invalid extraction -> no calendar write.

nodes.title: EXPLICIT SCREEN REQUEST
nodes.body: Fresh trusted owner turn + supported host/session lifecycle. Bind capture permission to the selected foreground window and current generation.

nodes.title: FOREGROUND OCR
nodes.body: Foreground-only capture/OCR with byte/pixel/text/age bounds. No ambient capture; raw screen images are not uploaded by this OCR path.

nodes.title: TEXT EXPLANATION
nodes.body: Tool-less explanation adapter receives bounded untrusted OCR text + the owner's question, not execution instructions.

nodes.title: PRIVATE ANSWER / CLEANUP
nodes.body: Scoped speech/context handling; fresh provider/session generation where required; close/cancel clears evidence. No retained screenshot unless explicitly authorised.

nodes.title: CAMERA / VISION REQUEST
nodes.body: On-demand object/window question; shared camera lease or permitted active-window image path. Phone photos are a separate explicit ingest source.

nodes.title: VISION ADAPTER
nodes.body: Configured vision client/fallbacks answer the specific question. WhatsApp photo descriptions feed the text conversation. Camera consumers share the hub.

nodes.title: OPTIONAL WATCHERS
nodes.body: Watch mode, appearance/posture/phone/gesture checks, window metadata and registered activity/build/event monitoring. Each has its own consent/flag/scope.

nodes.title: OBSERVATIONS, NOT AUTHORITY
nodes.body: Answer, watch briefing, draft suggestion or notification -> Section 11/12. Observation does not authorize clicking, sending, coding or arbitrary remediation.

nodes.title: SIGNAL SOURCES
nodes.body: Calendar/deadlines/mail/jobs/system telemetry, exam schedule, due reminders/calls, focus drift and allowlisted public event feeds.

nodes.title: TRIGGER / MONITOR ENGINE
nodes.body: Thresholds, time windows, dedupe, job state and public evidence. Optional event triage uses a separate free-router adapter, not the Perplexity persona router.

nodes.title: DELIVERY POLICY
nodes.body: Quiet hours, daily caps, batching, active/idle/unknown presence, mute/school/call conditions and queue TTL. Scheduled calls require supported phone readiness and valid invitations.

nodes.title: NOTIFY / QUEUE / CALL
nodes.body: Immediate permitted speech + caption/toast, silent desktop notification, queued announcement after activity, scheduled reminder or phone invitation. Queue/invitation is not proof of delivery.

nodes.title: REGISTERED JOB / SERVICE
nodes.body: Bridge supervisors and Tauri sidecars, agent worker, wake/microphone, local LiveKit, task/assigner jobs and supported goodnight inventory.

nodes.title: HEALTH & CANCELLATION
nodes.body: Liveness/readiness; Gemini reconnect/failover; tool latency; opted-in health recorder; explicit job cancellation and settled outcomes. Failures return bounded errors.

nodes.title: SUPPORTED GOODNIGHT V2
nodes.body: Fresh owner audio ingress -> registered-scope activity / busy checks and fencing -> ten-minute idle policy -> session lock with readback, when eligible. Old watcher is retired.

nodes.title: STATE / DIAGNOSTIC OUTPUT
nodes.body: Recovered job state, truthful failure/cancel receipt, health/latency report, archive status or verified lock. No global claim over unrelated external coding apps.

nodes.title: PAPER-MARKET INPUT
nodes.body: Quote feeds, calendar and persisted paper portfolio / replay data. Dedicated paper-market services run separately from voice.

nodes.title: SIMULATION / OPTIONAL TA
nodes.body: Paper engine/strategy/replay and separately configured TradingAgents analysis. These are not live broker trade execution paths.

nodes.title: PAPER STATE / INSIGHTS
nodes.body: Local positions, fills, charts, replay metrics, reports and AI-usage tracker data are exposed through read-only dashboard proxies.

nodes.title: DASHBOARD OUTPUT
nodes.body: HUD/Insights paper-market panels and usage view. Optional notifications retain delivery policy. Paper fills are simulations, not real trades.

nodes.title: AUDIO / CONVERSATION
nodes.body: Native Gemini audio; Piper/inference TTS; laptop or phone speakers; spoken handoff/completion/error; interruption-aware playback.

nodes.title: TEXT / VISUAL UI
nodes.body: Live captions, HUD state/cards/panels, archive viewer, watch briefing, game windows, desktop toasts, usage/paper dashboards and visible browser pages.

nodes.title: MESSAGES / CALLS
nodes.body: Gmail replies/acknowledgements, WhatsApp auto-replies or confirmed sends, configured Telegram responses, owner handoff alerts and bounded phone invitations.

nodes.title: FILES / CLOUD OBJECTS
nodes.body: Drafts, reports, source lists, code proposals, downloaded video, generated documents/invoices, Drive/Docs/Sheets/Notion changes and confirmed calendar entries.

nodes.title: DESKTOP / DEVICE EFFECTS
nodes.body: Open/focus/arrange apps and windows; volume/media/network/display/lighting changes; optional smart-home/KDE Connect effects; approved input or power operations.

nodes.title: PERSISTENCE / EVIDENCE
nodes.body: JSON/SQLite state, memory vault, indexes, drafts, consent records, job revisions, action logs, captions, monitor events and cancellation/verification receipts.

nodes.title: GUARDED CONSEQUENCES
nodes.body: Send/post/pay/book/delete/deploy/update actions require their existing exact-context approvals where applicable. Prepared content or a model's yes is not approval.

nodes.title: NO OUTPUT IS A VALID BRANCH
nodes.body: Filtered mail/chat; no new input; duplicate; blocked/guest/private restriction; mute/quiet queue; uncertain evidence; declined preview; handoff; unsupported feature.

nodes.title: PERPLEXITY / OPENROUTER
nodes.body:
1. Email urgency/phishing + event gate (09).
2. WhatsApp persona selection (08).
3. Direct/backend/research/code advice + backend guard (04/06).
Typed probabilities; no generated response text.

nodes.title: CREDENTIAL / CONFIG BOUNDARY
nodes.body: Dedicated decision key in private env/keys.env; model/feature switches; existing OAuth/subscription logins. Never include key values in prompts, logs or this guide.

nodes.title: CONTEXT / ACTION BOUNDARY
nodes.body: Memory, files, web pages, messages, OCR and tool replies are evidence. Application-owned session identity and fresh owner approvals authorize effects.

nodes.title: PERSIST / RETURN / RETRY
nodes.body: Archive/state feeds status and future context. Specific provider quota errors may trigger bounded failover. Timers/queues can defer delivery; error/unknown stays explicit.
